caption: The drawing features a single transparent glass mug with a rounded body and a circular opening at the top. The glass exhibits a light blue-green tint, indicative of clear glass, and subtle shading suggests its transparency and three-dimensional form. The mug has a prominent, curved handle attached to the right side, also rendered with the same glassy texture and color. Around the lower half of the mug, there are raised decorative patterns shaped like flowing lines and rounded protrusions, resembling abstract designs or embellishments typically found on ornate glassware. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery included. In the bottom left corner, there is a handwritten signature.
title: Mug
